reference: R.C. Sharma and Y.A. Chang, Bull. Alloy Phase Diagrams, 10(4), 334-339 (1989) doi:10.1007/bf02877588; compiled in H. Okamoto, Desk Handbook: Phase Diagrams for Binary Alloys, 2nd ed., ASM International, Materials Park, OH (2010), p. 262
comment: evidence_class=assessed_phase_diagram (expert-drawn diagram, not experimental, not CALPHAD); ORCHID assessed-phase-assemblages v1.0.0, diagram CD-TE-p262; one point per phase field (centroid or pole of inaccessibility); single-phase: the phase at the point composition; two-phase: phases present, compositions unknown (null) with __HYPERPLANE__ at the point's overall composition. Phase names mapped to CdTe-09Liu.tdb through the ORCHID phase registry (points whose phases are not all in that TDB are left out).

orchid_uncertainty_budget.sigma_rule: max(sqrt(max(printed, reading, method)^2 + composition^2 + conversion^2), scatter); boundary margin reported, not combined
